chunks: And it is narrated that he (peace be upon him) was asked: Where was our Lord before He created the heaven and the earth? Therefore, he (peace be upon him) replied,
“Where” [ayna] is a question about space, and Allah existed when there was no space.
ai.seo_question: Where was God before He created the universe?
ai.summary: In al-Tawhid, Shaykh al-Saduq records this foundational hadith to clarify the concept of divine transcendence (tanzih) by distinguishing between the created category of 'place' (makan) and the uncreated essence of God. The Imam’s response underscores that 'where' denotes spatial containment, which did not exist prior to creation; thus, God existed in a state of absolute being without being confined by space. This reasoning is central to Shia theological discourse on the negation of physical attributes (jawhar) from the Divine.
